note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described; synonymy, literature citations, distributions and figure numbers are omitted; the original correction of the tibial apical spur formula is retained.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown; antennae brown with a paler scape; mandibles dark brown with yellowish brown bases; legs straw yellow; body yellow with a few brown patches. Cephalic and thoracic pilosity moderate, pilosity of the body denser. Body length 3.8–5.2 mm. Head capsule broadly oval, narrowed anteriorly, nearly as wide as long, length at the mandible bases 1.0–1.26 mm, maximum width 1.0–1.21 mm, width/length index 0.96–1.0. Antennae 16–17-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Labrum ligulate with several long setae, longer than wide, apex broadly rounded and narrowed, length 0.26–0.37 mm, width 0.26–0.32 mm. Mandibles sickle-shaped, strongly incurved apically, about three quarters of the head length, length 0.79–0.89 mm, mandible length/head length ratio 0.75–0.79. Left mandible with a distinct, pointed, anteriorly directed tooth at about the apical third, 0.26–0.34 mm from the apex. The minute tooth of the right mandible lies slightly below that of the left mandible. Postmentum strongly arched and inflated, slightly narrower than long, length 0.53 mm, maximum width 0.47 mm, width/length index 0.92. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins strongly notched, length 0.47–0.58 mm, width 0.79–0.95 mm. Mesonotum and metanotum as wide as the pronotum, both with nearly straight posterior margins. Tibial apical spur formula 3:2:2, not 2:2:2 as recorded by Roonwal and Verma (1973).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, body straw yellow. Cephalic pilosity sparse, pilosity of the body denser. Body length 3.70–5.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate and rounded, length at the mandible bases 1.16–1.53 mm, width 1.32–1.42 mm. Antennae 17-segmented, segment 2 nearly as long as segments 3 and 4 together, the latter two subequal. Postclypeus inflated, with a few setae, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, distinctly notched medially on the anterior margin, posterior margin weakly incurved, length 0.30–0.38 mm, width 0.68–0.75 mm. Tibial apical spur formula 3:2:2.
